title: [GMCP 203.039.06] Operations and evidence: Server supervision and lifecycle orchestration
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-039-06. Ship inspectable CLI, TUI or API state, configuration validation, bounded metrics/logs/traces, diagnostics, examples, migration and rollback guidance, incident runbooks, and reproducible evidence artifacts. Automate drift detection so a changed dependency or standard invalidates stale proof. Vector outcome: A durable supervisor starts servers in dependency order, health-checks readiness and liveness, applies bounded restart/backoff/quarantine, drains and reloads without losing admitted work, propagates cancellation, reaps process trees and exposes exact state/reason. Boot storms, crash loops, hangs, upgrades, resource exhaustion and host restart converge automatically without duplicate instances or silent capability loss. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
